_comment: The shape HANDOVER-C012 §3.2 asks Cowork for. One object per file.
path        relative to --root, which defaults to this file's own directory.
Forward or backslashes, no leading slash, no '..'.
fund        the fund SLUG as the platform holds it, not the folder name.
Run `npm run import:fund-docs -- --list` to print the real ones.
category    one of the seven, verbatim, including the spaces in
title       what an investor sees in the document list. This plus fund and
category is the identity used to skip a file already present, so
a title edited between runs uploads a second copy.
description optional, shown under the title.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored, so this block may stay in a
The seven categories: Overview, Private Placement Memorandum, Legal Documents,
Financials, Technical, Correspondence, Pitch Deck / Presentation.
CW012 §3.2 said nine; nine was the pre-migration-006 count and two were merged
